content.title: The Baptist Faith and Message (2000)
content.author: Southern Baptist Convention · adopted 2000; article VI amended 2023
content.note: The statement of faith of the Southern Baptist Convention and this site's own doctrinal standard (DOCTRINAL-FOUNDATION.md). Cited by article. © Southern Baptist Convention: short phrases with a link only, never long quotation; check the current wording at bfm.sbc.net before quoting a phrase. Where it is silent, the guides show the views Baptists hold and do not choose. Scripture judges every confession.
content.read: The live text at bfm.sbc.net/bfm2000/ opened on 2026-11-27: eighteen articles (I The Scriptures to XVIII The Family); article VI notes its amendment by the 2023 Convention on 14 June 2023. No copy is held. Articles I–VII, XI, XII and XV read in full on 2026-11-27 at bfm.sbc.net for the 21 field articles; every phrase the articles quote was checked against that live text. 2026-11-27 (plan APOLOGETICS-FIELDS step 6): Article II (God the Son) and article I re-read at bfm.sbc.net/bfm2000/ for the step-6 samples (resurrection-case, jesus-outside-nt, titles-of-jesus); described, with at most a few words quoted. 2026-11-27 (plan APOLOGETICS-FIELDS step 6, atonement and Hume articles): Articles I, II (section B) and the opening of IV re-read at bfm.sbc.net/bfm2000/ for penal-substitution-objections and hume-miracles; only 'substitutionary death' (article II) quoted. Article II does not name Jesus' miracles, and hume-miracles does not say it does.
